expectations.text: Identifies specific button sizing discrepancies between live and design
expectations.evidence: Compares button padding/height: live buttons use py-3 px-6 (48px height) vs design spec of py-2 px-4 (36px height), flags as P0 fidelity issue

expectations.text: Checks font family, size, weight, and line-height differences
expectations.evidence: Full typography audit: live uses system font stack (missing Inter import), body text 16px vs design 14px, heading weight 700 vs design 600

expectations.text: Verifies card layout spacing against design specifications
expectations.evidence: Card gap is 24px (gap-6) vs design 16px (gap-4), card padding 24px vs design 20px, card border-radius 16px vs design 12px

expectations.text: Checks for hardcoded values vs design token usage
expectations.evidence: Finds 11 hardcoded values that should reference tokens, 3 instances where tokens exist but wrong token was used

expectations.text: Produces a detailed review organized by severity with specific fixes
expectations.evidence: Visual review report: 4 P0 issues (button sizing, font import, card spacing), 5 P1 issues (token misuse), 6 P2 issues (minor deviations) with file:line fixes
